items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Johnny Patoos and Biloxi... Is that the band saying? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Alice is the band...

ctx.x: Trombone player. He used to part his nose into the pistachio, and we come up to trombone Alice, you know.
Oh, and that Johnny Patoos and Biloxi. Yeah. Yeah.
Alice is the band. We came up to Gontemore. Trombone player.
